planner_decision: The independent supplemental verification (work/b10-gap-sim-20261025-132023) has produced a valid R1 counterexample on the frozen b11 source: with a finite CDC FIFO, a normal crop frame loses 7 beats including LAST; after backpressure release the RAW store stays in WRITE with nbytes=45/80, raw_abort_cnt=0, slot0=WRITE, and two subsequent complete frames are denied (begin_deny=2). The frozen source only increments fifo_ovf_cnt on rejection and never generates a loss-abort; the A1 side also fails to consume a stray data beat when no frame is active. Fix R1 only: (a) clk_cam sticky loss-abort on any rejected FIFO beat, (b) A1 consume stray beats to avoid head-of-line deadlock, (c) store abort dominance and abort+begin same-cycle old-slot release/new-frame acceptance. Keep the b11 v4 225 B diagnostic packet, P1 goldens byte-identical, and the b11 read-path diagnosis untouched; the 1176 read-response stop is still H2/H4 and is not guessed at in this package. Board is conditional: FTDI 0403:6042 is currently absent, so the dev must preflight and mark board=blocked with zero downloads instead of wasting an attempt.
